'''Crate-busters''' were manual labor workers who worked loading and unloading cargo on [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Some crate-busters were permanent members of a starship's crew, handling the transfer of cargo, or were employed by [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] to conduct the same jobs. Crate-busters were usually from [[Species/Legends|species]] that were physically powerful, such as the [[Sludir]]. Crate-busters used [[crate hook]]s to assist in their duties.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>
